duzeltme.govde: Ayla owns a small print shop. Last year her accounting profit was \$80,000. duzeltme.secenekler[3].text: She earned an economic profit of \$65,000, because only the forgone rent is an implicit cost.

3. Ekonomik kâr = 80,000 − 85,000 = −\$5,000 → ekonomik zarar.
